in_sanskrit.name: Kuwar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the sky
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kuwar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kūp’, meaning a well or pool. The name Kuwar is a masculine given name that signifies the ‘Lord of the Sky’. In Hindu mythology, Kuwar is often associated with Indra, the God of rain and thunder.

in_marathi.name: Kuwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kuwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kūp’, meaning a well or pool. The name Kuwar is a masculine given name that signifies the ‘Lord of the Sky’. In Hindu mythology, Kuwar is often associated with Indra, the God of rain and thunder.
